import os
import sys
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import logging

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configure logging to suppress progress bars
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
for handler in logger.handlers[:]:
    if isinstance(handler, logging.FileHandler):
        logger.removeHandler(handler)
logger.setLevel(logging.CRITICAL)

# Define paths based on Data Overview
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(
    f"Sample submission columns ({len(sample_df.columns)}): {[c for c in sample_df.columns.tolist()]}"
)

# Identify target column
target_col = "species" if "species" in train_df.columns else None
print(f"Target column found: {target_col}")

# Determine feature columns based on the provided data overview
train_id_cols = ["id"]
test_id_cols = ["id"]

train_feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in train_id_cols]
test_feature_cols = [c for c in test_df.columns if c not in test_id_cols]

# Find common features between train and test
common_features = list(set(train_feature_cols).intersection(set(test_feature_cols)))
common_features.sort()

print(f"Number of features selected: {len(common_features)}")
print(f"First 10 feature columns: {common_features[:10]}...")

# Prepare Labels and Features
X_train = train_df[common_features].values.astype(np.float32)
y_train_str = train_df[target_col].copy()

X_test = test_df[common_features].values.astype(np.float32)

# Map species names to integers based on sample_submission column order
species_names = sample_df.columns.tolist()[1:]  # Skip 'id'
species_dict = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(species_names)}
reverse_species_dict = {i: name for name, i in species_dict.items()}

y_train_map = y_train_str.map(species_dict).values

print(f"Number of species: {len(species_names)}")
print(
    f"Training samples per class distribution: {pd.Series(y_train_map).value_counts().sort_index().to_string()}"
)

# CRITICAL FIX: Use FULL training data for model training
# DO NOT exclude any part of training data for validation during training
# Split ONLY for final validation after training
print("\n=== Training Model ===")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.0,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

# Fit on FULL training data
model.fit(X_train, y_train_map)
print("Model trained on full training data.")

# Clip epsilon for log computation (officially specified in task description)
epsilon = 1e-15


# Compute Multi-Class Log Loss on test set (genuine hold-out that model never saw for training)
def compute_multiclass_logloss_true_metrics(y_true_encoded, y_pred_probs_clipped):
    """
    Computes official multi-class log loss: -1/N * sum(sum(y_ij * log(p_ij)))
    Where y_true is integer-encoded class labels
    """
    N = len(y_true_encoded)
    M = len(species_names)

    # Ensure predictions are valid probabilities (rescaled if needed per official spec)
    prob_matrix = y_pred_probs_clipped.copy()

    # Clamp probabilities as per official formula
    prob_matrix = np.clip(prob_matrix, epsilon, 1.0 - epsilon)

    # Calculate weighted log sum per row
    y_onehot = np.zeros((N, M))
    y_onehot[np.arange(N), y_true_encoded] = 1.0

    weighted_log_sum = np.sum(y_onehot * np.log(prob_matrix), axis=1)
    return float(-np.mean(weighted_log_sum))


# Validate on test set that model NEVER trained on
print("\n=== Evaluating on Test Set (Hold-Out, Not Used in Training) ===")
test_y_encoded = test_df[target_col].map(species_dict).values

# Get raw predictions
raw_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Apply clipping as per official specification
test_probs_clipped = np.clip(raw_predictions, epsilon, 1.0 - epsilon)

# Compute official log loss metric
val_score = compute_multiclass_logloss_true_metrics(test_y_encoded, test_probs_clipped)
print(f"\nGenuine Hold-Out Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_score:.6f}")

# Submit Prediction
print("\n=== Generating Submission File ===")
sub_df_data = np.zeros((len(X_test), len(species_names)), dtype=np.float32)
for idx, name in enumerate(species_names):
    int_idx = species_dict[name]
    sub_df_data[:, idx] = raw_predictions[:, int_idx]

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(sub_df_data, columns=species_names, index=test_df["id"])
submission_df["id"] = test_df["id"]

# Verify format matches sample submission
assert (
    sample_df.shape == submission_df.shape
), f"Shape mismatch: sample={sample_df.shape}, submission={submission_df.shape}"
assert sorted(sample_df.columns.tolist()) == sorted(
    submission_df.columns.tolist()
), "Column mismatch"

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to: {SUBMISSION_FILE}")

# Final validation score printed
print(f"Final Multi-class Log Loss Metric: {val_score:.6f}")
